whatsapp: Tap the name at the top (iPhone) or ⋮ → More (Android)

telegram: Open Telegram Desktop on a computer
Open the chat → ⋮ → Export chat history
Untick photos and videos, choose format 'Machine-readable JSON'

Export the conversation as text or CSV
instagram: Instagram → Settings → Your activity → Download your information
When the email arrives, upload the conversation's message_1.json

items.a: An AI character — Patrik — who reads a chat you upload and writes an honest, funny report about everyone in it: the real dynamic, who cares more, what changed, and everyone's role.

The preview is free: Patrik's opening, the numbers, and the titles of everything in the full report. The full report is a one-off payment (or one credit from a pack) — no subscription, and the price includes tax.
WhatsApp (iPhone and Android), Telegram, LINE and KakaoTalk exports, plus iMessage, Instagram and Messenger through their data exports. Screen-recording import is coming soon.

Patrik counts your messages inside your browser first. The upload is encrypted, never shared with anyone in the chat, never sold, and never used to train AI. It's deleted automatically 48 hours after upload if you don't order a report, or 7 days after your latest report.

items.q: Will people in the chat know?
items.a: No. Nobody is notified. A report is only seen by people you send the link to.
Your chat can be in any language or a mix. Reports are written in 36 languages, and Patrik uses the chat's own slang.
The preview takes about a minute. The full report about two minutes. We email you when it's ready, so you don't have to wait on the page.
Yes. Under every report you can ask a follow-up question about the same chat. Each answer is a new, deeper report.

items.q: How do I delete my data?
items.a: From 'My chats' you can delete a chat, a report or your whole account at any time.
The numbers are counted exactly from your export. The opinions are Patrik's — AI can misread context, so treat it as entertainment, not advice.
Adults (18+) who want a laugh, a reality check, or proof they were right all along.

about.title: About What Patrik Thinks
body: What Patrik Thinks is a small independent studio project. We built the character we wished existed: Patrik, a wedding DJ who spent twelve years watching couples, families and friend groups from behind the decks — and now reads your chats and tells you the truth.
Patrik reads WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, KakaoTalk, iMessage, Instagram and Messenger chats and writes in 36 languages.
We care about privacy more than anyone in this category: your chat is counted in your browser first, deleted automatically, and never used to train AI.
facts: AI chat reports for friends, couples and families
Free preview, then pay per report. No subscription.
